citations.quote: Aftermarket equipment above $1,000 is covered only if listed in the Declarations.

For theft of your covered auto, you must report the theft to the police within 48 hours of discovering it. We will pay for loss only after 30 days have passed without recovery of the vehicle, unless the vehicle is recovered earlier in damaged condition.

output.reasoning: The claim involves an aftermarket audio system valued at $3,000. According to clause [EXC-6], aftermarket equipment above $1,000 is only covered if listed in the Declarations. The claimant explicitly stated they 'never told the insurer about' the system, meaning it is not listed in the Declarations. Furthermore, the claim is for the theft of a component (the sound system) rather than the 'theft of the entire vehicle' required by [COMP-3] for theft coverage.
